This raises a potential concern. Slabs placed at y=-1 will be half-height blocks. If they default to the bottom-half placement, the player will be walking on a surface that's 0.5 blocks lower than the surrounding grass blocks (which are full blocks at y=-1). This could create a step-down when entering the workshop. However, this is actually fine — it creates a natural "floor" feel and the player can still walk on it without jumping.
